args.assessment: Successfully secured A3 (safehouse lease), A4 (signals kit), and A5 (banking channel) for a nominal value of 85 points under Directorate authorization.

events_public.content: (principal, private to dsi) Our records: the split closed at round 10, and the clock takes 3% per round, so your nominal total came back at 45 — not 65.
